subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should the canonical fix for malformed workspace `SKILL.md` diagnostics be a dedicated `openclaw skills lint` command first, or must normal list/check/status/Web surfaces also show skipped-skill failures before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: Current main still has the silent-drop path, and the open PR is plausible but leaves a product-scope choice about which user-facing surfaces must carry diagnostics by default.

options.title: Accept lint-first plus follow-up scope
options.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92028 as the first diagnostic surface, then track normal status/Web visibility separately if still desired.

options.title: Require status/UI diagnostics in the same fix
options.body: Keep the issue open until skipped-skill failures flow through loader/status and visible CLI/Web consumers, not only a new lint command.

options.title: Narrow the request to documentation only
options.body: Document the frontmatter requirements without adding runtime diagnostics, accepting that malformed candidates can remain invisible until users run external checks.

recommendation.title: Accept lint-first plus follow-up scope
recommendation.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92028 as the first diagnostic surface, then track normal status/Web visibility separately if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses CLI/docs/product wording and parser-adjacent surfaces where path history shows repeated involvement.
